blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Members of BAYAN Central Visayas and multiple sectoral groups gathered along Colon Street in Cebu City on Monday, November 16, for a protest held alongside the 49th ASEAN Summit, opposing the planned visit of US President Donald Trump and the proposed Pax Silica agreement. The groups were also raising concerns over national sovereignty and sector-specific issues, including rising fuel prices, the proposed jeepney phaseout, education budget cuts, and tuition and other fee increases.
